description: Before you buy, approve or deposit: scans a contract's verified Solidity source (Sourcify; follows proxies to the implementation) for red flags with file, line and reason: blocklists, unbounded fee setters, owner balance edits, trading switches, owner mint, pause, upgradeability, arbitrary transferFrom (approval drain), arbitrary delegatecall, unprotected initializer, reentrancy order, unchecked calls, tx.origin auth, signature replay, weak randomness. Heuristic, not an audit. PAID: $0.020 per call in USDC on Base via x402, or use a 0.25 USDC transfer pass (pay_tx). See payment_options. By Lao K.

chain.description: Chain of the contract (default base). Payment is always USDC on Base.

follow.description: 1 (default) = if it is a proxy, also scan the implementation

pay_chain.description: Chain of pay_tx (default: inferred; 0x hash = base, base58 signature = solana)

pay_tx.description: Optional, for the plain-transfer option (no x402 needed): hash of a USDC transfer of >= 0.25 USDC to this server's receiving address (get it from the payment_options tool). One transfer unlocks every paid tool for 24h.

name: solidity_red_flag_scan
title: Solidity Red-Flag Scan ($0.020)
